  1231→// Constants for formatting output
  1232→const (
  1233→	// maxIntentDisplayLength is the maximum length for intent text before truncation
  1234→	maxIntentDisplayLength = 80
  1235→	// maxMessageDisplayLength is the maximum length for checkpoint messages before truncation
  1236→	maxMessageDisplayLength = 80
  1237→	// maxPromptDisplayLength is the maximum length for session prompts before truncation
  1238→	maxPromptDisplayLength = 60
  1239→	// checkpointIDDisplayLength is the number of characters to show from checkpoint IDs
  1240→	checkpointIDDisplayLength = 12
  1241→)
  1242→
  1243→// formatBranchCheckpoints formats checkpoint information for a branch.
  1244→// Groups commits by checkpoint ID and shows the prompt for each checkpoint.
  1245→func formatBranchCheckpoints(branchName string, points []strategy.RewindPoint) string {
  1246→	var sb strings.Builder
  1247→
  1248→	// Branch header
  1249→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Branch: %s\n", branchName)
  1250→
  1251→	if len(points) == 0 {
  1252→		sb.WriteString("Checkpoints: 0\n")
  1253→		sb.WriteString("\nNo checkpoints found on this branch.\n")
  1254→		sb.WriteString("Checkpoints will appear here after you save changes during a Claude session.\n")
  1255→		return sb.String()
  1256→	}
  1257→
  1258→	// Group by checkpoint ID
  1259→	groups := groupByCheckpointID(points)
  1260→
  1261→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoints: %d\n", len(groups))
  1262→	sb.WriteString("\n")
  1263→
  1264→	// Output each checkpoint group
  1265→	for _, group := range groups {
  1266→		formatCheckpointGroup(&sb, group)
  1267→		sb.WriteString("\n")
  1268→	}
  1269→
  1270→	return sb.String()
  1271→}
  1272→
  1273→// checkpointGroup represents a group of commits sharing the same checkpoint ID.
  1274→type checkpointGroup struct {
  1275→	checkpointID string
  1276→	prompt       string
  1277→	isTemporary  bool // true if any commit is not logs-only (can be rewound)
  1278→	isTask       bool // true if this is a task checkpoint
  1279→	commits      []commitEntry
  1280→}
  1281→
  1282→// commitEntry represents a single git commit within a checkpoint.
  1283→type commitEntry struct {
  1284→	date    time.Time
  1285→	gitSHA  string // short git SHA
  1286→	message string
  1287→}
  1288→
  1289→// groupByCheckpointID groups rewind points by their checkpoint ID.
  1290→// Returns groups sorted by latest commit timestamp (most recent first).
  1291→func groupByCheckpointID(points []strategy.RewindPoint) []checkpointGroup {
  1292→	if len(points) == 0 {
  1293→		return nil
  1294→	}
  1295→
  1296→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> group
  1297→	groupMap := make(map[string]*checkpointGroup)
  1298→	var order []string // Track insertion order for stable iteration
  1299→
  1300→	for _, point := range points {
  1301→		// Determine the checkpoint ID to use for grouping
  1302→		cpID := point.CheckpointID.String()
  1303→		if cpID == "" {
  1304→			// Temporary checkpoints: group by session ID to preserve per-session prompts
  1305→			// Use session ID prefix for readability (format: YYYY-MM-DD-uuid)
  1306→			cpID = point.SessionID
  1307→			if cpID == "" {
  1308→				cpID = "temporary" // Fallback if no session ID
  1309→			}
  1310→		}
  1311→
  1312→		group, exists := groupMap[cpID]
  1313→		if !exists {
  1314→			group = &checkpointGroup{
  1315→				checkpointID: cpID,
  1316→				prompt:       point.SessionPrompt,
  1317→				isTemporary:  !point.IsLogsOnly,
  1318→				isTask:       point.IsTaskCheckpoint,
  1319→			}
  1320→			groupMap[cpID] = group
  1321→			order = append(order, cpID)
  1322→		}
  1323→
  1324→		// Short git SHA (7 chars)
  1325→		gitSHA := point.ID
  1326→		if len(gitSHA) > 7 {
  1327→			gitSHA = gitSHA[:7]
  1328→		}
  1329→
  1330→		group.commits = append(group.commits, commitEntry{
  1331→			date:    point.Date,
  1332→			gitSHA:  gitSHA,
  1333→			message: point.Message,
  1334→		})
  1335→
  1336→		// Update flags - if any commit is temporary/task, the group is too
  1337→		if !point.IsLogsOnly {
  1338→			group.isTemporary = true
  1339→		}
  1340→		if point.IsTaskCheckpoint {
  1341→			group.isTask = true
  1342→		}
  1343→		// Update prompt if the group's prompt is empty but this point has one
  1344→		if group.prompt == "" && point.SessionPrompt != "" {
  1345→			group.prompt = point.SessionPrompt
  1346→		}
  1347→	}
  1348→
  1349→	// Sort commits within each group by date (most recent first)
  1350→	for _, group := range groupMap {
  1351→		sort.Slice(group.commits, func(i, j int) bool {
  1352→			return group.commits[i].date.After(group.commits[j].date)
  1353→		})
  1354→	}
  1355→
  1356→	// Build result slice in order, then sort by latest commit
  1357→	result := make([]checkpointGroup, 0, len(order))
  1358→	for _, cpID := range order {
  1359→		result = append(result, *groupMap[cpID])
  1360→	}
  1361→
  1362→	// Sort groups by latest commit timestamp (most recent first)
  1363→	sort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool {
  1364→		// Each group's commits are already sorted, so first commit is latest
  1365→		if len(result[i].commits) == 0 {
  1366→			return false
  1367→		}
  1368→		if len(result[j].commits) == 0 {
  1369→			return true
  1370→		}
  1371→		return result[i].commits[0].date.After(result[j].commits[0].date)
  1372→	})
  1373→
  1374→	return result
  1375→}
  1376→
  1377→// formatCheckpointGroup formats a single checkpoint group for display.
  1378→func formatCheckpointGroup(sb *strings.Builder, group checkpointGroup) {
  1379→	// Checkpoint ID (truncated for display)
  1380→	cpID := group.checkpointID
  1381→	if len(cpID) > checkpointIDDisplayLength {
  1382→		cpID = cpID[:checkpointIDDisplayLength]
  1383→	}
  1384→
  1385→	// Build status indicators
  1386→	// Skip [temporary] indicator when cpID is already "temporary" to avoid redundancy
  1387→	var indicators []string
  1388→	if group.isTask {
  1389→		indicators = append(indicators, "[task]")
  1390→	}
  1391→	if group.isTemporary && cpID != "temporary" {
  1392→		indicators = append(indicators, "[temporary]")
  1393→	}
  1394→
  1395→	indicatorStr := ""
  1396→	if len(indicators) > 0 {
  1397→		indicatorStr = " " + strings.Join(indicators, " ")
  1398→	}
  1399→
  1400→	// Prompt (truncated)
  1401→	var promptStr string
  1402→	if group.prompt == "" {
  1403→		promptStr = "(no prompt)"
  1404→	} else {
  1405→		// Quote actual prompts
  1406→		promptStr = fmt.Sprintf("%q", strategy.TruncateDescription(group.prompt, maxPromptDisplayLength))
  1407→	}
  1408→
  1409→	// Checkpoint header: [checkpoint_id] [indicators] prompt
  1410→	fmt.Fprintf(sb, "[%s]%s %s\n", cpID, indicatorStr, promptStr)
  1411→
  1412→	// List commits under this checkpoint
  1413→	for _, commit := range group.commits {
  1414→		// Format: "  MM-DD HH:MM (git_sha) message"
  1415→		dateTimeStr := commit.date.Format("01-02 15:04")
  1416→		message := strategy.TruncateDescription(commit.message, maxMessageDisplayLength)
  1417→		fmt.Fprintf(sb, "  %s (%s) %s\n", dateTimeStr, commit.gitSHA, message)
  1418→	}
  1419→}
  1420→
  1421→// hasCodeChanges returns true if the commit has changes to non-metadata files.
  1422→// Used by getBranchCheckpoints to filter out metadata-only temporary checkpoints.
  1423→// Returns false only if the commit has a parent AND only modified .entire/ metadata files.
  1424→//
  1425→// First commits (no parent) are always considered to have code changes since they
  1426→// capture the working copy state at session start - real uncommitted work.
  1427→//
  1428→// This filters out periodic transcript saves that don't change code.
  1429→func hasCodeChanges(commit *object.Commit) bool {
  1430→	// First commit on shadow branch captures working copy state - always meaningful
  1431→	if commit.NumParents() == 0 {
  1432→		return true
  1433→	}
  1434→
  1435→	parent, err := commit.Parent(0)
  1436→	if err != nil {
  1437→		return true // Can't check, assume meaningful
  1438→	}
  1439→
  1440→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
  1441→	if err != nil {
  1442→		return true
  1443→	}
  1444→
  1445→	parentTree, err := parent.Tree()
  1446→	if err != nil {
  1447→		return true
  1448→	}
  1449→
  1450→	changes, err := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1451→	if err != nil {
  1452→		return true
  1453→	}
  1454→
  1455→	// Check if any non-metadata file was changed
  1456→	for _, change := range changes {
  1457→		name := change.To.Name
  1458→		if name == "" {
  1459→			name = change.From.Name
  1460→		}
  1461→		// Skip .entire/ metadata files
  1462→		if !strings.HasPrefix(name, ".entire/") {
  1463→			return true
  1464→		}
  1465→	}
  1466→
  1467→	return false
  1468→}

   209→	result, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   210→	if err != nil {
   211→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   212→	}
   213→	if result == nil {
   214→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", fullCheckpointID)
   215→	}
   216→
   217→	// Handle summary generation
   218→	if generate {
   219→		if err := generateCheckpointSummary(w, errW, store, fullCheckpointID, result, force); err != nil {
   220→			return err
   221→		}
   222→		// Reload the result to get the updated summary
   223→		result, err = store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   224→		if err != nil {
   225→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reload checkpoint: %w", err)
   226→		}
   227→	}
   228→
   229→	// Look up the commit message for this checkpoint
   230→	commitMessage := findCommitMessageForCheckpoint(repo, fullCheckpointID)
   231→
   232→	// Format and output
   233→	output := formatCheckpointOutput(result, fullCheckpointID, commitMessage, verbose, full)
   234→	outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   235→	return nil
   236→}

   238→// generateCheckpointSummary generates an AI summary for a checkpoint and persists it.
   239→func generateCheckpointSummary(w, errW io.Writer, store *checkpoint.GitStore, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, result *checkpoint.ReadCommittedResult, force bool) error {
   240→	// Check if summary already exists
   241→	if result.Metadata.Summary != nil && !force {
   242→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s already has a summary (use --force to regenerate)", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   243→	}
   244→
   245→	// Check if transcript exists
   246→	if len(result.Transcript) == 0 {
   247→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s has no transcript to summarise", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Build condensed transcript for summarisation
   251→	condensed, err := summarise.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(result.Transcript)
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→	if len(condensed) == 0 {
   256→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s transcript has no content to summarise", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	input := summarise.Input{
   260→		Transcript:   condensed,
   261→		FilesTouched: result.Metadata.FilesTouched,
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// Show progress indicator
   265→	fmt.Fprintln(errW, "Generating summary...")
   266→
   267→	// Generate summary using Claude CLI
   268→	generator := &summarise.ClaudeGenerator{}
   269→	ctx := context.Background()
   270→	summary, err := generator.Generate(ctx, input)
   271→	if err != nil {
   272→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate summary: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	// Persist the summary
   276→	if err := store.UpdateSummary(ctx, checkpointID, summary); err != nil {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save summary: %w", err)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	fmt.Fprintln(w, "Summary generated and saved.")
   281→	return nil
   282→}

   284→// explainTemporaryCheckpoint finds and formats a temporary checkpoint by shadow commit hash prefix.
   285→// Returns the formatted output and whether the checkpoint was found.
   286→func explainTemporaryCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, store *checkpoint.GitStore, shaPrefix string, verbose, full bool) (string, bool) {
   287→	// Get current HEAD to find shadow branch
   288→	head, err := repo.Head()
   289→	if err != nil {
   290→		return "", false
   291→	}
   292→	headShort := head.Hash().String()[:7]
   293→
   294→	// List temporary checkpoints on current shadow branch
   295→	tempCheckpoints, err := store.ListTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), headShort, "", branchCheckpointsLimit)
   296→	if err != nil {
   297→		return "", false
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Find checkpoints matching the SHA prefix - check for ambiguity
   301→	var matches []checkpoint.TemporaryCheckpointInfo
   302→	for _, tc := range tempCheckpoints {
   303→		if strings.HasPrefix(tc.CommitHash.String(), shaPrefix) {
   304→			matches = append(matches, tc)
   305→		}
   306→	}
   307→
   308→	if len(matches) == 0 {
   309→		return "", false
   310→	}
   311→
   312→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   313→		// Multiple matches - return ambiguous error as output
   314→		var sb strings.Builder
   315→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Ambiguous checkpoint prefix %q matches %d temporary checkpoints:\n\n", shaPrefix, len(matches))
   316→		for _, m := range matches {
   317→			shortID := m.CommitHash.String()[:7]
   318→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  %s  %s  session %s\n",
   319→				shortID,
   320→				m.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
   321→				m.SessionID)
   322→		}
   323→		sb.WriteString("\nPlease use a longer checkpoint prefix to disambiguate.\n")
   324→		return sb.String(), true
   325→	}
   326→
   327→	tc := matches[0]
   328→
   329→	// Found exactly one match - read metadata from shadow branch commit tree
   330→	shadowCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(tc.CommitHash)
   331→	if commitErr != nil {
   332→		return "", false
   333→	}
   334→
   335→	shadowTree, treeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   336→	if treeErr != nil {
   337→		return "", false
   338→	}
   339→
   340→	// Read prompts from shadow branch
   341→	sessionPrompt := strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(shadowTree, tc.MetadataDir)
   342→
   343→	// Build output similar to formatCheckpointOutput but for temporary
   344→	var sb strings.Builder
   345→	shortID := tc.CommitHash.String()[:7]
   346→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoint: %s [temporary]\n", shortID)
   347→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", tc.SessionID)
   348→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Created: %s\n", tc.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   349→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   350→
   351→	// Intent from prompt
   352→	intent := "(not available)"
   353→	if sessionPrompt != "" {
   354→		lines := strings.Split(sessionPrompt, "\n")
   355→		if len(lines) > 0 && lines[0] != "" {
   356→			intent = strategy.TruncateDescription(lines[0], maxIntentDisplayLength)
   357→		}
   358→	}
   359→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", intent)
   360→	sb.WriteString("Outcome: (not generated)\n")
   361→
   362→	// Verbose: show prompts
   363→	if verbose || full {
   364→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   365→		sb.WriteString("Prompts:\n")
   366→		if sessionPrompt != "" {
   367→			sb.WriteString(sessionPrompt)
   368→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   369→		} else {
   370→			sb.WriteString("  (none)\n")
   371→		}
   372→	}
   373→
   374→	// Full: show transcript
   375→	if full {
   376→		// Try to read transcript from shadow branch
   377→		transcriptPath := tc.MetadataDir + "/full.jsonl"
   378→		if transcriptFile, fileErr := shadowTree.File(transcriptPath); fileErr == nil {
   379→			if content, readErr := transcriptFile.Contents(); readErr == nil {
   380→				sb.WriteString("\n")
   381→				sb.WriteString("Transcript:\n")
   382→				sb.WriteString(content)
   383→				sb.WriteString("\n")
   384→			}
   385→		}
   386→	}
   387→
   388→	return sb.String(), true
   389→}

   391→// findCommitMessageForCheckpoint searches git history for a commit with the
   392→// Entire-Checkpoint trailer matching the given checkpoint ID, and returns
   393→// the first line of the commit message. Returns empty string if not found.
   394→func findCommitMessageForCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   395→	// Get HEAD reference
   396→	head, err := repo.Head()
   397→	if err != nil {
   398→		return ""
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	// Iterate through commit history (limit to recent commits for performance)
   402→	commitIter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   403→		From: head.Hash(),
   404→	})
   405→	if err != nil {
   406→		return ""
   407→	}
   408→	defer commitIter.Close()
   409→
   410→	count := 0
   411→
   412→	for {
   413→		commit, iterErr := commitIter.Next()
   414→		if iterErr != nil {
   415→			break
   416→		}
   417→		count++
   418→		if count > commitScanLimit {
   419→			break
   420→		}
   421→
   422→		// Check if this commit has our checkpoint ID
   423→		foundID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   424→		if hasTrailer && foundID == checkpointID {
   425→			// Return first line of commit message (without trailing newline)
   426→			firstLine := strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0]
   427→			return strings.TrimSpace(firstLine)
   428→		}
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	return ""
   432→}

   434→// formatCheckpointOutput formats checkpoint data based on verbosity level.
   435→// When verbose is false: summary only (ID, session, timestamp, tokens, intent).
   436→// When verbose is true: adds prompts, files, and commit message details.
   437→// When full is true: includes the complete transcript in addition to verbose details.
   438→func formatCheckpointOutput(result *checkpoint.ReadCommittedResult, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, commitMessage string, verbose, full bool) string {
   439→	var sb strings.Builder
   440→	meta := result.Metadata
   441→
   442→	// Header - always shown
   443→	// Note: CheckpointID is always exactly 12 characters, matching checkpointIDDisplayLength
   444→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoint: %s\n", checkpointID)
   445→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", meta.SessionID)
   446→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Created: %s\n", meta.CreatedAt.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   447→
   448→	// Token usage
   449→	if meta.TokenUsage != nil {
   450→		totalTokens := meta.TokenUsage.InputTokens + meta.TokenUsage.CacheCreationTokens +
   451→			meta.TokenUsage.CacheReadTokens + meta.TokenUsage.OutputTokens
   452→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Tokens: %d\n", totalTokens)
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   456→
   457→	// Intent and Outcome from AI summary, or fallback to prompt text
   458→	if meta.Summary != nil {
   459→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", meta.Summary.Intent)
   460→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Outcome: %s\n", meta.Summary.Outcome)
   461→	} else {
   462→		// Fallback: use first line of prompts for intent
   463→		intent := "(not generated)"
   464→		if result.Prompts != "" {
   465→			lines := strings.Split(result.Prompts, "\n")
   466→			if len(lines) > 0 && lines[0] != "" {
   467→				intent = strategy.TruncateDescription(lines[0], maxIntentDisplayLength)
   468→			}
   469→		}
   470→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", intent)
   471→		sb.WriteString("Outcome: (not generated)\n")
   472→	}
   473→
   474→	// Verbose: add commit message, learnings, friction, files, and prompts
   475→	if verbose || full {
   476→		// AI Summary details (learnings, friction, open items)
   477→		if meta.Summary != nil {
   478→			formatSummaryDetails(&sb, meta.Summary)
   479→		}
   480→
   481→		// Commit message section (only if available)
   482→		if commitMessage != "" {
   483→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   484→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Commit: %s\n", commitMessage)
   485→		}
   486→
   487→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   488→
   489→		// Files section
   490→		if len(meta.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   491→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files: (%d)\n", len(meta.FilesTouched))
   492→			for _, file := range meta.FilesTouched {
   493→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
   494→			}
   495→		} else {
   496→			sb.WriteString("Files: (none)\n")
   497→		}
   498→
   499→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   500→
   501→		// Prompts section
   502→		sb.WriteString("Prompts:\n")
   503→		if result.Prompts != "" {
   504→			sb.WriteString(result.Prompts)
   505→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   506→		} else {
   507→			sb.WriteString("  (none)\n")
   508→		}
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Full: add transcript
   512→	if full {
   513→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   514→		sb.WriteString("Transcript:\n")
   515→		if len(result.Transcript) > 0 {
   516→			sb.Write(result.Transcript)
   517→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   518→		} else {
   519→			sb.WriteString("  (none)\n")
   520→		}
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	return sb.String()
   524→}

   588→
   589→// branchCheckpointsLimit is the max checkpoints to show in branch view
   590→const branchCheckpointsLimit = 100
   591→
   592→// commitScanLimit is how far back to scan git history for checkpoints
   593→const commitScanLimit = 500
   594→
   595→// consecutiveMainLimit stops scanning after this many consecutive commits on main
   596→// (indicates we've likely exhausted feature branch commits)
   597→const consecutiveMainLimit = 100
   598→
   599→// errStopIteration is used to stop commit iteration early
   600→var errStopIteration = errors.New("stop iteration")
   601→
   602→// getBranchCheckpoints returns checkpoints relevant to the current branch.
   603→// This is strategy-agnostic - it queries checkpoints directly from the checkpoint store.
   604→//
   605→// Behavior:
   606→//   - On feature branches: only show checkpoints unique to this branch (not in main)
   607→//   - On default branch (main/master): show all checkpoints in history (up to limit)
   608→//   - Includes both committed checkpoints (entire/sessions) and temporary checkpoints (shadow branches)
   609→func getBranchCheckpoints(repo *git.Repository, limit int) ([]strategy.RewindPoint, error) {
   610→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   611→
   612→	// Get all committed checkpoints for lookup
   613→	committedInfos, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   614→	if err != nil {
   615→		committedInfos = nil // Continue without committed checkpoints
   616→	}
   617→
   618→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> committed info
   619→	committedByID := make(map[id.CheckpointID]checkpoint.CommittedInfo)
   620→	for _, info := range committedInfos {
   621→		if !info.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   622→			committedByID[info.CheckpointID] = info
   623→		}
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	head, err := repo.Head()
   627→	if err != nil {
   628→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   629→	}
   630→
   631→	// Check if we're on the default branch (use repo-aware version)
   632→	isOnDefault, _ := strategy.IsOnDefaultBranch(repo)
   633→	var mainBranchHash plumbing.Hash
   634→	if !isOnDefault {
   635→		mainBranchHash = strategy.GetMainBranchHash(repo)
   636→	}
   637→
   638→	// Walk git history and collect checkpoints
   639→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   640→		From:  head.Hash(),
   641→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
   642→	})
   643→	if err != nil {
   644→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   645→	}
   646→	defer iter.Close()
   647→
   648→	// Fetch metadata branch tree once (used for reading session prompts)
   649→	metadataTree, _ := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, continue without prompts
   650→
   651→	var points []strategy.RewindPoint
   652→	count := 0
   653→	consecutiveMainCount := 0
   654→
   655→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   656→		if count >= commitScanLimit {
   657→			return errStopIteration
   658→		}
   659→		count++
   660→
   661→		// On feature branches, skip commits that are reachable from main
   662→		// (but continue scanning - there may be more feature branch commits)
   663→		if mainBranchHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   664→			if isAncestorOf(repo, c.Hash, mainBranchHash) {
   665→				consecutiveMainCount++
   666→				if consecutiveMainCount >= consecutiveMainLimit {
   667→					return errStopIteration // Likely exhausted feature branch commits
   668→				}
   669→				return nil // Skip this commit, continue scanning
   670→			}
   671→			consecutiveMainCount = 0 // Reset on feature branch commit
   672→		}
   673→
   674→		// Extract checkpoint ID from Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   675→		cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(c.Message)
   676→		if !found {
   677→			return nil // No checkpoint trailer, continue
   678→		}
   679→
   680→		// Look up checkpoint info
   681→		cpInfo, found := committedByID[cpID]
   682→		if !found {
   683→			return nil // Checkpoint not in store, continue
   684→		}
   685→
   686→		// Create rewind point from committed info
   687→		message := strings.Split(c.Message, "\n")[0]
   688→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   689→			ID:           c.Hash.String(),
   690→			Message:      message,
   691→			Date:         c.Committer.When,
   692→			IsLogsOnly:   true, // Committed checkpoints are logs-only
   693→			CheckpointID: cpID,
   694→			SessionID:    cpInfo.SessionID,
   695→		}
   696→
   697→		// Read session prompt from metadata branch (best-effort)
   698→		if metadataTree != nil {
   699→			point.SessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(metadataTree, cpID.Path())
   700→		}
   701→
   702→		points = append(points, point)
   703→		return nil
   704→	})
   705→
   706→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopIteration) {
   707→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	// Also get temporary checkpoints from shadow branch for current HEAD
   711→	headShort := head.Hash().String()[:7]
   712→	tempCheckpoints, _ := store.ListTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), headShort, "", limit) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, continue without temp checkpoints
   713→	for _, tc := range tempCheckpoints {
   714→		shadowCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(tc.CommitHash)
   715→		if commitErr != nil {
   716→			continue
   717→		}
   718→
   719→		// Filter out checkpoints with no code changes (only .entire/ metadata changed)
   720→		// This also filters out the first checkpoint which is just a baseline copy
   721→		if !hasCodeChanges(shadowCommit) {
   722→			continue
   723→		}
   724→
   725→		// Read session prompt from the shadow branch commit's tree (not from entire/sessions)
   726→		// Temporary checkpoints store their metadata in the shadow branch, not in entire/sessions
   727→		var sessionPrompt string
   728→		shadowTree, treeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   729→		if treeErr == nil {
   730→			sessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(shadowTree, tc.MetadataDir)
   731→		}
   732→
   733→		points = append(points, strategy.RewindPoint{
   734→			ID:               tc.CommitHash.String(),
   735→			Message:          tc.Message,
   736→			MetadataDir:      tc.MetadataDir,
   737→			Date:             tc.Timestamp,
   738→			IsTaskCheckpoint: tc.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   739→			ToolUseID:        tc.ToolUseID,
   740→			SessionID:        tc.SessionID,
   741→			SessionPrompt:    sessionPrompt,
   742→			IsLogsOnly:       false, // Temporary checkpoints can be fully rewound
   743→		})
   744→	}
   745→
   746→	// Sort by date, most recent first
   747→	sort.Slice(points, func(i, j int) bool {
   748→		return points[i].Date.After(points[j].Date)
   749→	})
   750→
   751→	// Apply limit
   752→	if len(points) > limit {
   753→		points = points[:limit]
   754→	}
   755→
   756→	return points, nil
   757→}

   759→// isAncestorOf checks if commit is an ancestor of (or equal to) target.
   760→// Returns true if target can reach commit by following parent links.
   761→func isAncestorOf(repo *git.Repository, commit, target plumbing.Hash) bool {
   762→	if commit == target {
   763→		return true
   764→	}
   765→
   766→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: target})
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		return false
   769→	}
   770→	defer iter.Close()
   771→
   772→	found := false
   773→	count := 0
   774→	_ = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error { //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort search, errors are non-fatal
   775→		count++
   776→		if count > 1000 {
   777→			return errStopIteration
   778→		}
   779→		if c.Hash == commit {
   780→			found = true
   781→			return errStopIteration
   782→		}
   783→		return nil
   784→	})

   786→	return found

   870→// gatherCurrentSessionDetails attempts to get transcript info for sessions without checkpoints.
   871→// This handles strategies like shadow where active sessions may not have checkpoint commits.
   872→func gatherCurrentSessionDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   873→	// Try to get transcript via GetSessionContext which reads from metadata branch
   874→	// For shadow, we can read the transcript from the same location pattern
   875→	contextContent := strat.GetSessionContext(session.ID)
   876→	if contextContent == "" {
   877→		return nil
   878→	}
   879→
   880→	// Parse the context.md to extract the last prompt/summary
   881→	// Context.md typically has sections like "# Prompt\n...\n## Summary\n..."
   882→	detail := checkpointDetail{
   883→		Index:     1,
   884→		Timestamp: session.StartTime,
   885→		Message:   "Current session",
   886→	}
   887→
   888→	// Try to extract prompt and summary from context.md
   889→	lines := strings.Split(contextContent, "\n")
   890→	var inPrompt, inSummary bool
   891→	var promptLines, summaryLines []string
   892→
   893→	for _, line := range lines {
   894→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   895→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "prompt") {
   896→			inPrompt = true
   897→			inSummary = false
   898→			continue
   899→		}
   900→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "summary") {
   901→			inPrompt = false
   902→			inSummary = true
   903→			continue
   904→		}
   905→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") {
   906→			inPrompt = false
   907→			inSummary = false
   908→			continue
   909→		}
   910→
   911→		if inPrompt {
   912→			promptLines = append(promptLines, line)
   913→		} else if inSummary {
   914→			summaryLines = append(summaryLines, line)
   915→		}
   916→	}
   917→
   918→	var inter interaction
   919→	if len(promptLines) > 0 {
   920→		inter.Prompt = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(promptLines, "\n"))
   921→	}
   922→	if len(summaryLines) > 0 {
   923→		inter.Responses = []string{strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(summaryLines, "\n"))}
   924→	}
   925→
   926→	// If we couldn't parse structured content, show the raw context
   927→	if inter.Prompt == "" && len(inter.Responses) == 0 {
   928→		inter.Responses = []string{contextContent}
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	if inter.Prompt != "" || len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   932→		detail.Interactions = []interaction{inter}
   933→	}
   934→
   935→	return []checkpointDetail{detail}
   936→}

   938→// gatherCheckpointDetails extracts detailed information for each checkpoint.
   939→// Checkpoints come in newest-first order, but we number them oldest=1, newest=N.
   940→func gatherCheckpointDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   941→	details := make([]checkpointDetail, 0, len(session.Checkpoints))
   942→	total := len(session.Checkpoints)
   943→
   944→	for i, cp := range session.Checkpoints {
   945→		detail := checkpointDetail{
   946→			Index:            total - i, // Reverse numbering: oldest=1, newest=N
   947→			Timestamp:        cp.Timestamp,
   948→			IsTaskCheckpoint: cp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   949→			Message:          cp.Message,
   950→		}
   951→
   952→		// Use checkpoint ID for display (truncate long IDs)
   953→		detail.ShortID = cp.CheckpointID.String()
   954→		if len(detail.ShortID) > 12 {
   955→			detail.ShortID = detail.ShortID[:12]
   956→		}
   957→
   958→		// Try to get transcript for this checkpoint
   959→		transcriptContent, err := strat.GetCheckpointLog(cp)
   960→		if err == nil {
   961→			transcript, parseErr := parseTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptContent)
   962→			if parseErr == nil {
   963→				// Extract all prompt/response pairs from the transcript
   964→				pairs := ExtractAllPromptResponses(transcript)
   965→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   966→					detail.Interactions = append(detail.Interactions, interaction(pair))
   967→				}
   968→
   969→				// Aggregate all files for the checkpoint
   970→				fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
   971→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   972→					for _, f := range pair.Files {
   973→						if !fileSet[f] {
   974→							fileSet[f] = true
   975→							detail.Files = append(detail.Files, f)
   976→						}
   977→					}
   978→				}
   979→			}
   980→		}
   981→
   982→		details = append(details, detail)
   983→	}
   984→
   985→	return details
   986→}

   988→// runExplainCommit explains a specific commit.
   989→func runExplainCommit(w io.Writer, commitRef string) error {
   990→	repo, err := openRepository()
   991→	if err != nil {
   992→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   993→	}
   994→
   995→	// Resolve the commit reference
   996→	hash, err := repo.ResolveRevision(plumbing.Revision(commitRef))
   997→	if err != nil {
   998→		return fmt.Errorf("commit not found: %s", commitRef)
   999→	}
  1000→
  1001→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(*hash)
  1002→	if err != nil {
  1003→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
  1004→	}
  1005→
  1006→	// Get files changed in this commit (diff from parent to current)
  1007→	var files []string
  1008→	commitTree, err := commit.Tree()
  1009→	if err == nil && commit.NumParents() > 0 {
  1010→		parent, parentErr := commit.Parent(0)
  1011→		if parentErr == nil {
  1012→			parentTree, treeErr := parent.Tree()
  1013→			if treeErr == nil {
  1014→				// Diff from parent to current commit to show what changed
  1015→				changes, diffErr := parentTree.Diff(commitTree)
  1016→				if diffErr == nil {
  1017→					for _, change := range changes {
  1018→						name := change.To.Name
  1019→						if name == "" {
  1020→							name = change.From.Name
  1021→						}
  1022→						files = append(files, name)
  1023→					}
  1024→				}
  1025→			}
  1026→		}
  1027→	}
  1028→
  1029→	// Check for Entire metadata - try multiple trailer types
  1030→	metadataDir, hasMetadata := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
  1031→	sessionID, hasSession := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
  1032→	checkpointID, hasCheckpoint := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
  1033→
  1034→	// If no session trailer, try to extract from metadata path.
  1035→	// Note: extractSessionIDFromMetadata is defined in rewind.go as it's used
  1036→	// by both the rewind and explain commands for parsing metadata paths.
  1037→	if !hasSession && hasMetadata {
  1038→		sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(metadataDir)
  1039→		hasSession = sessionID != ""
  1040→	}
  1041→
  1042→	// Build commit info
  1043→	fullSHA := hash.String()
  1044→	shortSHA := fullSHA
  1045→	if len(fullSHA) >= 7 {
  1046→		shortSHA = fullSHA[:7]
  1047→	}
  1048→
  1049→	info := &commitInfo{
  1050→		SHA:       fullSHA,
  1051→		ShortSHA:  shortSHA,
  1052→		Message:   strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0], // First line only
  1053→		Author:    commit.Author.Name,
  1054→		Email:     commit.Author.Email,
  1055→		Date:      commit.Author.When,
  1056→		Files:     files,
  1057→		HasEntire: hasMetadata || hasSession || hasCheckpoint,
  1058→		SessionID: sessionID,
  1059→	}
  1060→
  1061→	// If we have a checkpoint ID but no session, try to look up session from metadata
  1062→	if hasCheckpoint && sessionID == "" {
  1063→		if result, err := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo).ReadCommitted(context.Background(), checkpointID); err == nil && result != nil {
  1064→			info.SessionID = result.Metadata.SessionID
  1065→		}
  1066→	}
  1067→
  1068→	// Format and output
  1069→	output := formatCommitInfo(info)
  1070→	fmt.Fprint(w, output)
  1071→
  1072→	return nil
  1073→}

  1075→// formatSessionInfo formats session information for display.

  1078→

  1082→
  1083→	if !session.StartTime.IsZero() {

  1085→	}
  1086→
  1087→	if sourceRef != "" {
  1088→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Source Ref: %s\n", sourceRef)
  1089→	}
  1090→
  1091→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoints: %d\n", len(checkpoints))
  1092→
  1093→	// Checkpoint details
  1094→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {

  1096→
  1097→		// Checkpoint header

  1099→		if cp.IsTaskCheckpoint {

  1102→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "─── Checkpoint %d [%s] %s%s ───\n",
  1103→			cp.Index, cp.ShortID, cp.Timestamp.Format("2006-01-02 15:04"), taskMarker)
  1104→		sb.WriteString("\n")
  1105→
  1106→		// Display all interactions in this checkpoint
  1107→		for i, inter := range cp.Interactions {
  1108→			// For multiple interactions, add a sub-header
  1109→			if len(cp.Interactions) > 1 {
  1110→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "### Interaction %d\n\n", i+1)
  1111→			}
  1112→
  1113→			// Prompt section
  1114→			if inter.Prompt != "" {
  1115→				sb.WriteString("## Prompt\n\n")
  1116→				sb.WriteString(inter.Prompt)
  1117→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
  1118→			}
  1119→
  1120→			// Response section
  1121→			if len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
  1122→				sb.WriteString("## Responses\n\n")
  1123→				sb.WriteString(strings.Join(inter.Responses, "\n\n"))
  1124→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")

  1126→
  1127→			// Files modified for this interaction
  1128→			if len(inter.Files) > 0 {
  1129→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files Modified (%d):\n", len(inter.Files))
  1130→				for _, file := range inter.Files {
  1131→					fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)

  1133→				sb.WriteString("\n")
  1134→			}
  1135→		}
  1136→
  1137→		// If no interactions, show message and/or files
  1138→		if len(cp.Interactions) == 0 {
  1139→			// Show commit message as summary when no transcript available
  1140→			if cp.Message != "" {
  1141→				sb.WriteString(cp.Message)
  1142→				sb.WriteString("\n\n")
  1143→			}
  1144→			// Show aggregate files if available
  1145→			if len(cp.Files) > 0 {
  1146→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files Modified (%d):\n", len(cp.Files))
  1147→				for _, file := range cp.Files {
  1148→					fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
  1149→				}
  1150→			}
  1151→		}
  1152→	}
  1153→
  1154→	return sb.String()
  1155→}

  1192→// outputWithPager outputs content through a pager if stdout is a terminal and content is long.
  1193→func outputWithPager(w io.Writer, content string) {
  1194→	// Check if we're writing to stdout and it's a terminal
  1195→	if f, ok := w.(*os.File); ok && f == os.Stdout && term.IsTerminal(int(f.Fd())) {
  1196→		// Get terminal height
  1197→		_, height, err := term.GetSize(int(f.Fd()))
  1198→		if err != nil {
  1199→			height = 24 // Default fallback
  1200→		}
  1201→
  1202→		// Count lines in content
  1203→		lineCount := strings.Count(content, "\n")
  1204→
  1205→		// Use pager if content exceeds terminal height
  1206→		if lineCount > height-2 {
  1207→			pager := os.Getenv("PAGER")
  1208→			if pager == "" {
  1209→				pager = "less"
  1210→			}
  1211→
  1212→			cmd := exec.CommandContext(context.Background(), pager) //nolint:gosec // pager from env is expected
  1213→			cmd.Stdin = strings.NewReader(content)
  1214→			cmd.Stdout = f
  1215→			cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
  1216→
  1217→			if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
  1218→				// Fallback to direct output if pager fails
  1219→				fmt.Fprint(w, content)
  1220→			}
  1221→			return
  1222→		}
  1223→	}
  1224→
  1225→	// Direct output for non-terminal or short content
  1226→	fmt.Fprint(w, content)
  1227→}

  1271→// checkpointGroup represents a group of commits sharing the same checkpoint ID.
  1272→type checkpointGroup struct {
  1273→	checkpointID string
  1274→	prompt       string
  1275→	isTemporary  bool // true if any commit is not logs-only (can be rewound)
  1276→	isTask       bool // true if this is a task checkpoint
  1277→	commits      []commitEntry
  1278→}
  1279→
  1280→// commitEntry represents a single git commit within a checkpoint.
  1281→type commitEntry struct {
  1282→	date    time.Time
  1283→	gitSHA  string // short git SHA
  1284→	message string
  1285→}
  1286→
  1287→// groupByCheckpointID groups rewind points by their checkpoint ID.
  1288→// Returns groups sorted by latest commit timestamp (most recent first).
  1289→func groupByCheckpointID(points []strategy.RewindPoint) []checkpointGroup {
  1290→	if len(points) == 0 {
  1291→		return nil
  1292→	}
  1293→
  1294→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> group
  1295→	groupMap := make(map[string]*checkpointGroup)
  1296→	var order []string // Track insertion order for stable iteration
  1297→
  1298→	for _, point := range points {
  1299→		// Determine the checkpoint ID to use for grouping
  1300→		cpID := point.CheckpointID.String()
  1301→		if cpID == "" {
  1302→			// Temporary checkpoints: group by session ID to preserve per-session prompts
  1303→			// Use session ID prefix for readability (format: YYYY-MM-DD-uuid)
  1304→			cpID = point.SessionID
  1305→			if cpID == "" {
  1306→				cpID = "temporary" // Fallback if no session ID
  1307→			}
  1308→		}
  1309→
  1310→		group, exists := groupMap[cpID]
  1311→		if !exists {
  1312→			group = &checkpointGroup{
  1313→				checkpointID: cpID,
  1314→				prompt:       point.SessionPrompt,
  1315→				isTemporary:  !point.IsLogsOnly,
  1316→				isTask:       point.IsTaskCheckpoint,
  1317→			}
  1318→			groupMap[cpID] = group
  1319→			order = append(order, cpID)
  1320→		}
  1321→
  1322→		// Short git SHA (7 chars)
  1323→		gitSHA := point.ID
  1324→		if len(gitSHA) > 7 {
  1325→			gitSHA = gitSHA[:7]
  1326→		}
  1327→
  1328→		group.commits = append(group.commits, commitEntry{
  1329→			date:    point.Date,
  1330→			gitSHA:  gitSHA,
  1331→			message: point.Message,
  1332→		})
  1333→
  1334→		// Update flags - if any commit is temporary/task, the group is too
  1335→		if !point.IsLogsOnly {
  1336→			group.isTemporary = true
  1337→		}
  1338→		if point.IsTaskCheckpoint {
  1339→			group.isTask = true
  1340→		}
  1341→		// Update prompt if the group's prompt is empty but this point has one
  1342→		if group.prompt == "" && point.SessionPrompt != "" {
  1343→			group.prompt = point.SessionPrompt
  1344→		}
  1345→	}
  1346→
  1347→	// Sort commits within each group by date (most recent first)
  1348→	for _, group := range groupMap {
  1349→		sort.Slice(group.commits, func(i, j int) bool {

message.content: Q: what happens if the extracted transcript is too large?

content.thinking:
The user is asking about what happens if the extracted/condensed transcript is too large to send to the Claude CLI for summarization. This is a good question - there's currently no size limit or truncation logic in the code.

Let me think about this:

1. The `BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes` parses the full transcript and extracts all user prompts, assistant responses, and tool calls
2. `FormatCondensedTranscript` formats all of these into a string
3. This string is then passed to the Claude CLI via stdin

If the session is very long (many interactions), the condensed transcript could exceed Claude's context window or cause other issues.

Current behavior: No truncation - the full condensed transcript is sent to Claude CLI. If it's too large, Claude CLI would likely:
- Fail with a context length error
- Or potentially truncate internally (depending on Claude CLI behavior)

This is a gap in the implementation that should be addressed.

content.text:
Good question. Currently there's **no truncation** - the full condensed transcript is sent to Claude CLI. If it exceeds Claude's context window, the CLI would fail with an error.

Options to address this:

1. **Truncate from the beginning** - Keep the most recent interactions (end of session usually has the outcome)
2. **Truncate from the middle** - Keep first prompt + last N interactions (intent + outcome)
3. **Token estimation** - Rough char-to-token ratio (~4 chars/token) and truncate to stay under limit
4. **Let Claude CLI handle it** - Claude CLI might handle this gracefully already (needs testing)

Which approach would you prefer? I'd lean toward option 2 (keep first prompt for intent + recent interactions for outcome) with a configurable max size.

The user is pointing out that even with 1M context, we're just pushing the problem further rather than solving it fundamentally. They're asking about strategies for handling really long transcripts.

The challenge is: how do you summarize something without reading all of it? Some options:

1. **Hierarchical summarization** - Break into chunks, summarize each chunk, then summarize the summaries. This is a common approach for long documents.

2. **Sliding window with overlap** - Process in windows, combine summaries

3. **Strategic sampling** - Take first prompt (intent), last N interactions (outcome), and sample key moments (tool calls that modified files)

4. **Map-reduce style** - Map: extract key info from each section. Reduce: combine into final summary.

5. **Progressive summarization** - Summarize as you go during the session, not at the end

6. **Focus on structure, not content** - The transcript has structure (user prompts, assistant responses, tool calls). We could:
   - Always include first user prompt (intent)
   - Always include last few exchanges (outcome)
   - For the middle, just list tool calls and file modifications without full content
   - This is basically what the condensed transcript already does!

Actually, looking at what we already have - `BuildCondensedTranscript` already extracts just:
- User prompts (content)
- Assistant text responses (content) 
- Tool calls (just name + description/path, not full content)

This is already a form of compression. The question is: is the condensed version still too large?

For a really long session, even the condensed version could be large because:
- Many user prompts
- Many assistant text responses
- Many tool calls

A tiered approach could work:

**Tier 1: Full condensed transcript** (if it fits in context)
- All user prompts, assistant responses, tool calls with details

**Tier 2: Reduced condensed** (if Tier 1 is too large)


- First user prompt (full)
- Tool calls (name only, no details)
- Last N assistant responses
- Last user prompt

**Tier 3: Metadata only** (if even Tier 2 is too large)
- First user prompt
- List of files touched
- Count of tool calls by type
- Last assistant response

The real value comes from capturing intent (the initial request), outcome (final exchanges showing what was accomplished), and activity (which tools were used). A few strategies:

**1. Hierarchical summarization (map-reduce)**
- Split transcript into chunks (e.g., by user prompt boundaries)
- Summarize each chunk independently
- Summarize the summaries
- Downside: Multiple API calls, loses cross-chunk context

**2. Progressive reduction based on position**
Since our summary schema needs **intent** (beginning) and **outcome** (end), we could:
- **Always keep**: First user prompt + last N interactions (these are critical)
- **Compress middle**: Replace full content with just tool call names + file paths
- **Drop if needed**: Assistant explanatory text in the middle (tool calls tell the story)

This plays nicely with what `BuildCondensedTranscript` already does - we just need a "reduce" pass.

**3. Incremental summarization during session**
- Generate partial summaries at checkpoints as the session progresses
- Final summary merges checkpoint summaries
- Downside: More complexity, changes the architecture

I'd lean toward **option 2** - it's simple, keeps the critical parts (intent/outcome), and degrades gracefully:

```
Tier 1: Full condensed (fits in context) → use as-is
Tier 2: First prompt + tool names/files + last 10 interactions
Tier 3: First prompt + file list + last 3 interactions
```

input.title: Handle large transcript summarisation gracefully
input.description:
## Context

The `entire explain -c <checkpoint> --generate` feature uses Claude CLI to generate AI summaries from session transcripts. Currently, if a transcript exceeds Claude's context window, the CLI will fail with a non-zero exit code.

## Problem

Very long sessions could produce transcripts that exceed the context limit (200K for standard Sonnet, 1M for extended context). While this is an edge case, we should handle it gracefully.

## Potential Approaches

1. **Hierarchical summarisation (map-reduce)**
   - Split transcript into chunks (e.g., by user prompt boundaries)
   - Summarise each chunk independently
   - Summarise the summaries
   - Downside: Multiple API calls, loses cross-chunk context

2. **Progressive reduction based on position**
   - Always keep: First user prompt + last N interactions (critical for intent/outcome)
   - Compress middle: Replace full content with just tool call names + file paths
   - Drop if needed: Assistant explanatory text in the middle
   - Tiered approach:
     - Tier 1: Full condensed (fits in context) → use as-is
     - Tier 2: First prompt + tool names/files + last 10 interactions
     - Tier 3: First prompt + file list + last 3 interactions

3. **Incremental summarisation during session**
   - Generate partial summaries at checkpoints as session progresses
   - Final summary merges checkpoint summaries
   - Downside: More complexity, changes architecture

## Current State

- Using Sonnet model (200K context, 1M available via `sonnet[1m]`)
- Graceful failure: returns error message if context exceeded
- Condensed transcript format already reduces size significantly

## Next Steps

- Investigate typical transcript sizes in production
- Determine if this is a real problem or theoretical edge case
- If needed, implement tiered reduction (option 2) as simplest solution

The `entire explain -c <checkpoint> --generate` feature uses Claude CLI to generate AI summaries from session transcripts. Currently, if a transcript exceeds Claude's context window, the CLI will fail with a non-zero exit code.

## Problem

Very long sessions could produce transcripts that exceed the context limit (200K for standard Sonnet, 1M for extended context). While this is an edge case, we should handle it gracefully.

   * Always keep: First user prompt + last N interactions (critical for intent/outcome)

   157→// runExplainCheckpoint explains a specific checkpoint.
   158→// Supports both committed checkpoints (by checkpoint ID) and temporary checkpoints (by git SHA).
   159→// First tries to match committed checkpoints, then falls back to temporary checkpoints.
   160→// When generate is true, generates an AI summary for the checkpoint.
   161→// When force is true, regenerates even if a summary already exists.
   162→func runExplainCheckpoint(w, errW io.Writer, checkpointIDPrefix string, noPager, verbose, full, generate, force bool) error {
   163→	repo, err := openRepository()
   164→	if err != nil {
   165→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   166→	}
   167→
   168→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   169→
   170→	// First, try to find in committed checkpoints by checkpoint ID prefix
   171→	committed, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   172→	if err != nil {
   173→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoints: %w", err)
   174→	}
   175→
   176→	// Collect all matching checkpoint IDs to detect ambiguity
   177→	var matches []id.CheckpointID
   178→	for _, info := range committed {
   179→		if strings.HasPrefix(info.CheckpointID.String(), checkpointIDPrefix) {
   180→			matches = append(matches, info.CheckpointID)
   181→		}
   182→	}
   183→
   184→	var fullCheckpointID id.CheckpointID
   185→	switch len(matches) {
   186→	case 0:
   187→		// Not found in committed, try temporary checkpoints by git SHA
   188→		if generate {
   189→			return fmt.Errorf("cannot generate summary for temporary checkpoint %s (only committed checkpoints supported)", checkpointIDPrefix)
   190→		}
   191→		output, found := explainTemporaryCheckpoint(repo, store, checkpointIDPrefix, verbose, full)
   192→		if found {
   193→			outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   194→			return nil
   195→		}
   196→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", checkpointIDPrefix)
   197→	case 1:
   198→		fullCheckpointID = matches[0]
   199→	default:
   200→		// Ambiguous prefix - show up to 5 examples
   201→		examples := make([]string, 0, 5)
   202→		for i := 0; i < len(matches) && i < 5; i++ {
   203→			examples = append(examples, matches[i].String())
   204→		}
   205→		return fmt.Errorf("ambiguous checkpoint prefix %q matches %d checkpoints: %s", checkpointIDPrefix, len(matches), strings.Join(examples, ", "))
   206→	}
   207→
   208→	// Load checkpoint data
   209→	result, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   210→	if err != nil {
   211→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   212→	}
   213→	if result == nil {
   214→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", fullCheckpointID)
   215→	}
   216→
   217→	// Handle summary generation
   218→	if generate {
   219→		if err := generateCheckpointSummary(w, errW, store, fullCheckpointID, result, force); err != nil {
   220→			return err
   221→		}
   222→		// Reload the result to get the updated summary
   223→		result, err = store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), fullCheckpointID)
   224→		if err != nil {
   225→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to reload checkpoint: %w", err)
   226→		}
   227→	}
   228→
   229→	// Look up the commit message for this checkpoint
   230→	commitMessage := findCommitMessageForCheckpoint(repo, fullCheckpointID)
   231→
   232→	// Format and output
   233→	output := formatCheckpointOutput(result, fullCheckpointID, commitMessage, verbose, full)
   234→	outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   235→	return nil
   236→}

   238→// generateCheckpointSummary generates an AI summary for a checkpoint and persists it.
   239→func generateCheckpointSummary(w, errW io.Writer, store *checkpoint.GitStore, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, result *checkpoint.ReadCommittedResult, force bool) error {
   240→	// Check if summary already exists
   241→	if result.Metadata.Summary != nil && !force {
   242→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s already has a summary (use --force to regenerate)", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   243→	}
   244→
   245→	// Check if transcript exists
   246→	if len(result.Transcript) == 0 {
   247→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s has no transcript to summarise", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Build condensed transcript for summarisation
   251→	condensed, err := summarise.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes(result.Transcript)
   252→	if err != nil {
   253→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   254→	}
   255→	if len(condensed) == 0 {
   256→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint %s transcript has no content to summarise", checkpointID.String()[:checkpointIDDisplayLength])
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	input := summarise.Input{
   260→		Transcript:   condensed,
   261→		FilesTouched: result.Metadata.FilesTouched,
   262→	}
   263→
   264→	// Show progress indicator
   265→	fmt.Fprintln(errW, "Generating summary...")
   266→
   267→	// Generate summary using Claude CLI
   268→	generator := &summarise.ClaudeGenerator{}
   269→	ctx := context.Background()
   270→	summary, err := generator.Generate(ctx, input)
   271→	if err != nil {
   272→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate summary: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	// Persist the summary
   276→	if err := store.UpdateSummary(ctx, checkpointID, summary); err != nil {
   277→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save summary: %w", err)
   278→	}
   279→
   280→	fmt.Fprintln(w, "Summary generated and saved.")
   281→	return nil
   282→}

   391→// findCommitMessageForCheckpoint searches git history for a commit with the
   392→// Entire-Checkpoint trailer matching the given checkpoint ID, and returns
   393→// the first line of the commit message. Returns empty string if not found.
   394→func findCommitMessageForCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) string {
   395→	// Get HEAD reference
   396→	head, err := repo.Head()
   397→	if err != nil {
   398→		return ""
   399→	}
   400→
   401→	// Iterate through commit history (limit to recent commits for performance)
   402→	commitIter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   403→		From: head.Hash(),
   404→	})
   405→	if err != nil {
   406→		return ""
   407→	}
   408→	defer commitIter.Close()
   409→
   410→	count := 0
   411→
   412→	for {
   413→		commit, iterErr := commitIter.Next()
   414→		if iterErr != nil {
   415→			break
   416→		}
   417→		count++
   418→		if count > commitScanLimit {
   419→			break
   420→		}
   421→
   422→		// Check if this commit has our checkpoint ID
   423→		foundID, hasTrailer := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(commit.Message)
   424→		if hasTrailer && foundID == checkpointID {
   425→			// Return first line of commit message (without trailing newline)
   426→			firstLine := strings.Split(commit.Message, "\n")[0]
   427→			return strings.TrimSpace(firstLine)
   428→		}
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	return ""
   432→}

   434→// formatCheckpointOutput formats checkpoint data based on verbosity level.
   435→// When verbose is false: summary only (ID, session, timestamp, tokens, intent).
   436→// When verbose is true: adds prompts, files, and commit message details.
   437→// When full is true: includes the complete transcript in addition to verbose details.
   438→func formatCheckpointOutput(result *checkpoint.ReadCommittedResult, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, commitMessage string, verbose, full bool) string {
   439→	var sb strings.Builder
   440→	meta := result.Metadata
   441→
   442→	// Header - always shown
   443→	// Note: CheckpointID is always exactly 12 characters, matching checkpointIDDisplayLength
   444→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Checkpoint: %s\n", checkpointID)
   445→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Session: %s\n", meta.SessionID)
   446→	fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Created: %s\n", meta.CreatedAt.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"))
   447→
   448→	// Token usage
   449→	if meta.TokenUsage != nil {
   450→		totalTokens := meta.TokenUsage.InputTokens + meta.TokenUsage.CacheCreationTokens +
   451→			meta.TokenUsage.CacheReadTokens + meta.TokenUsage.OutputTokens
   452→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Tokens: %d\n", totalTokens)
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	sb.WriteString("\n")
   456→
   457→	// Intent and Outcome from AI summary, or fallback to prompt text
   458→	if meta.Summary != nil {
   459→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", meta.Summary.Intent)
   460→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Outcome: %s\n", meta.Summary.Outcome)
   461→	} else {
   462→		// Fallback: use first line of prompts for intent
   463→		intent := "(not generated)"
   464→		if result.Prompts != "" {
   465→			lines := strings.Split(result.Prompts, "\n")
   466→			if len(lines) > 0 && lines[0] != "" {
   467→				intent = strategy.TruncateDescription(lines[0], maxIntentDisplayLength)
   468→			}
   469→		}
   470→		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Intent: %s\n", intent)
   471→		sb.WriteString("Outcome: (not generated)\n")
   472→	}
   473→
   474→	// Verbose: add commit message, learnings, friction, files, and prompts
   475→	if verbose || full {
   476→		// AI Summary details (learnings, friction, open items)
   477→		if meta.Summary != nil {
   478→			formatSummaryDetails(&sb, meta.Summary)
   479→		}
   480→
   481→		// Commit message section (only if available)
   482→		if commitMessage != "" {
   483→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   484→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Commit: %s\n", commitMessage)
   485→		}
   486→
   487→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   488→
   489→		// Files section
   490→		if len(meta.FilesTouched) > 0 {
   491→			fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "Files: (%d)\n", len(meta.FilesTouched))
   492→			for _, file := range meta.FilesTouched {
   493→				fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "  - %s\n", file)
   494→			}
   495→		} else {
   496→			sb.WriteString("Files: (none)\n")
   497→		}
   498→
   499→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   500→
   501→		// Prompts section
   502→		sb.WriteString("Prompts:\n")
   503→		if result.Prompts != "" {
   504→			sb.WriteString(result.Prompts)
   505→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   506→		} else {
   507→			sb.WriteString("  (none)\n")
   508→		}
   509→	}
   510→
   511→	// Full: add transcript
   512→	if full {
   513→		sb.WriteString("\n")
   514→		sb.WriteString("Transcript:\n")
   515→		if len(result.Transcript) > 0 {
   516→			sb.Write(result.Transcript)
   517→			sb.WriteString("\n")
   518→		} else {
   519→			sb.WriteString("  (none)\n")
   520→		}
   521→	}
   522→
   523→	return sb.String()

   567→	if len(summary.Friction) > 0 {
   568→		sb.WriteString("\nFriction:\n")
   569→		for _, item := range summary.Friction {
   570→			fmt.Fprintf(sb, "  - %s\n", item)
   571→		}
   572→	}
   573→
   574→	// Open items section
   575→	if len(summary.OpenItems) > 0 {
   576→		sb.WriteString("\nOpen Items:\n")
   577→		for _, item := range summary.OpenItems {
   578→			fmt.Fprintf(sb, "  - %s\n", item)
   579→		}
   580→	}
   581→}

   589→// branchCheckpointsLimit is the max checkpoints to show in branch view
   590→const branchCheckpointsLimit = 100
   591→
   592→// commitScanLimit is how far back to scan git history for checkpoints
   593→const commitScanLimit = 500
   594→
   595→// consecutiveMainLimit stops scanning after this many consecutive commits on main
   596→// (indicates we've likely exhausted feature branch commits)
   597→const consecutiveMainLimit = 100
   598→
   599→// errStopIteration is used to stop commit iteration early
   600→var errStopIteration = errors.New("stop iteration")
   601→
   602→// getBranchCheckpoints returns checkpoints relevant to the current branch.
   603→// This is strategy-agnostic - it queries checkpoints directly from the checkpoint store.
   604→//
   605→// Behavior:
   606→//   - On feature branches: only show checkpoints unique to this branch (not in main)
   607→//   - On default branch (main/master): show all checkpoints in history (up to limit)
   608→//   - Includes both committed checkpoints (entire/sessions) and temporary checkpoints (shadow branches)
   609→func getBranchCheckpoints(repo *git.Repository, limit int) ([]strategy.RewindPoint, error) {
   610→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   611→
   612→	// Get all committed checkpoints for lookup
   613→	committedInfos, err := store.ListCommitted(context.Background())
   614→	if err != nil {
   615→		committedInfos = nil // Continue without committed checkpoints
   616→	}
   617→
   618→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> committed info
   619→	committedByID := make(map[id.CheckpointID]checkpoint.CommittedInfo)
   620→	for _, info := range committedInfos {
   621→		if !info.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   622→			committedByID[info.CheckpointID] = info
   623→		}
   624→	}
   625→
   626→	head, err := repo.Head()
   627→	if err != nil {
   628→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   629→	}
   630→
   631→	// Check if we're on the default branch (use repo-aware version)
   632→	isOnDefault, _ := strategy.IsOnDefaultBranch(repo)
   633→	var mainBranchHash plumbing.Hash
   634→	if !isOnDefault {
   635→		mainBranchHash = strategy.GetMainBranchHash(repo)
   636→	}
   637→
   638→	// Walk git history and collect checkpoints
   639→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   640→		From:  head.Hash(),
   641→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
   642→	})
   643→	if err != nil {
   644→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   645→	}
   646→	defer iter.Close()
   647→
   648→	// Fetch metadata branch tree once (used for reading session prompts)
   649→	metadataTree, _ := strategy.GetMetadataBranchTree(repo) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, continue without prompts
   650→
   651→	var points []strategy.RewindPoint
   652→	count := 0
   653→	consecutiveMainCount := 0
   654→
   655→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   656→		if count >= commitScanLimit {
   657→			return errStopIteration
   658→		}
   659→		count++
   660→
   661→		// On feature branches, skip commits that are reachable from main
   662→		// (but continue scanning - there may be more feature branch commits)
   663→		if mainBranchHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   664→			if isAncestorOf(repo, c.Hash, mainBranchHash) {
   665→				consecutiveMainCount++
   666→				if consecutiveMainCount >= consecutiveMainLimit {
   667→					return errStopIteration // Likely exhausted feature branch commits
   668→				}
   669→				return nil // Skip this commit, continue scanning
   670→			}
   671→			consecutiveMainCount = 0 // Reset on feature branch commit
   672→		}
   673→
   674→		// Extract checkpoint ID from Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   675→		cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(c.Message)
   676→		if !found {
   677→			return nil // No checkpoint trailer, continue
   678→		}
   679→
   680→		// Look up checkpoint info
   681→		cpInfo, found := committedByID[cpID]
   682→		if !found {
   683→			return nil // Checkpoint not in store, continue
   684→		}
   685→
   686→		// Create rewind point from committed info
   687→		message := strings.Split(c.Message, "\n")[0]
   688→		point := strategy.RewindPoint{
   689→			ID:           c.Hash.String(),
   690→			Message:      message,
   691→			Date:         c.Committer.When,
   692→			IsLogsOnly:   true, // Committed checkpoints are logs-only
   693→			CheckpointID: cpID,
   694→			SessionID:    cpInfo.SessionID,
   695→		}
   696→
   697→		// Read session prompt from metadata branch (best-effort)
   698→		if metadataTree != nil {
   699→			point.SessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(metadataTree, cpID.Path())
   700→		}
   701→
   702→		points = append(points, point)
   703→		return nil
   704→	})
   705→
   706→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStopIteration) {
   707→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	// Also get temporary checkpoints from shadow branch for current HEAD
   711→	headShort := head.Hash().String()[:7]
   712→	tempCheckpoints, _ := store.ListTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), headShort, "", limit) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort, continue without temp checkpoints
   713→	for _, tc := range tempCheckpoints {
   714→		shadowCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(tc.CommitHash)
   715→		if commitErr != nil {
   716→			continue
   717→		}
   718→
   719→		// Filter out checkpoints with no code changes (only .entire/ metadata changed)
   720→		// This also filters out the first checkpoint which is just a baseline copy
   721→		if !hasCodeChanges(shadowCommit) {
   722→			continue
   723→		}
   724→
   725→		// Read session prompt from the shadow branch commit's tree (not from entire/sessions)
   726→		// Temporary checkpoints store their metadata in the shadow branch, not in entire/sessions
   727→		var sessionPrompt string
   728→		shadowTree, treeErr := shadowCommit.Tree()
   729→		if treeErr == nil {
   730→			sessionPrompt = strategy.ReadSessionPromptFromTree(shadowTree, tc.MetadataDir)
   731→		}
   732→
   733→		points = append(points, strategy.RewindPoint{
   734→			ID:               tc.CommitHash.String(),
   735→			Message:          tc.Message,
   736→			MetadataDir:      tc.MetadataDir,
   737→			Date:             tc.Timestamp,
   738→			IsTaskCheckpoint: tc.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   739→			ToolUseID:        tc.ToolUseID,
   740→			SessionID:        tc.SessionID,
   741→			SessionPrompt:    sessionPrompt,
   742→			IsLogsOnly:       false, // Temporary checkpoints can be fully rewound
   743→		})
   744→	}
   745→
   746→	// Sort by date, most recent first
   747→	sort.Slice(points, func(i, j int) bool {
   748→		return points[i].Date.After(points[j].Date)
   749→	})
   750→
   751→	// Apply limit
   752→	if len(points) > limit {
   753→		points = points[:limit]
   754→	}
   755→
   756→	return points, nil
   757→}

   759→// isAncestorOf checks if commit is an ancestor of (or equal to) target.
   760→// Returns true if target can reach commit by following parent links.
   761→func isAncestorOf(repo *git.Repository, commit, target plumbing.Hash) bool {
   762→	if commit == target {
   763→		return true
   764→	}
   765→
   766→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{From: target})
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		return false
   769→	}
   770→	defer iter.Close()
   771→
   772→	found := false
   773→	count := 0
   774→	_ = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error { //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort search, errors are non-fatal
   775→		count++
   776→		if count > 1000 {
   777→			return errStopIteration
   778→		}
   779→		if c.Hash == commit {
   780→			found = true
   781→			return errStopIteration
   782→		}
   783→		return nil
   784→	})
   785→
   786→	return found
   787→}

   789→// runExplainBranchDefault shows all checkpoints on the current branch grouped by date.
   790→// This is strategy-agnostic - it queries checkpoints directly.
   791→func runExplainBranchDefault(w io.Writer, noPager bool) error {
   792→	repo, err := openRepository()
   793→	if err != nil {
   794→		return fmt.Errorf("not a git repository: %w", err)
   795→	}
   796→
   797→	// Get current branch name
   798→	branchName := strategy.GetCurrentBranchName(repo)
   799→	if branchName == "" {

   801→		head, headErr := repo.Head()
   802→		if headErr != nil {
   803→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", headErr)
   804→		}
   805→		branchName = "HEAD (" + head.Hash().String()[:7] + ")"
   806→	}
   807→
   808→	// Get checkpoints for this branch (strategy-agnostic)
   809→	points, err := getBranchCheckpoints(repo, branchCheckpointsLimit)
   810→	if err != nil {

   812→		logging.Warn(context.Background(), "failed to get branch checkpoints", "error", err)
   813→		points = nil
   814→	}
   815→
   816→	// Format output
   817→	output := formatBranchCheckpoints(branchName, points)
   818→
   819→	outputExplainContent(w, output, noPager)
   820→	return nil
   821→}

   870→// gatherCurrentSessionDetails attempts to get transcript info for sessions without checkpoints.
   871→// This handles strategies like shadow where active sessions may not have checkpoint commits.
   872→func gatherCurrentSessionDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   873→	// Try to get transcript via GetSessionContext which reads from metadata branch
   874→	// For shadow, we can read the transcript from the same location pattern
   875→	contextContent := strat.GetSessionContext(session.ID)
   876→	if contextContent == "" {
   877→		return nil
   878→	}
   879→
   880→	// Parse the context.md to extract the last prompt/summary
   881→	// Context.md typically has sections like "# Prompt\n...\n## Summary\n..."
   882→	detail := checkpointDetail{
   883→		Index:     1,
   884→		Timestamp: session.StartTime,
   885→		Message:   "Current session",
   886→	}
   887→
   888→	// Try to extract prompt and summary from context.md
   889→	lines := strings.Split(contextContent, "\n")
   890→	var inPrompt, inSummary bool
   891→	var promptLines, summaryLines []string
   892→
   893→	for _, line := range lines {
   894→		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)
   895→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "prompt") {
   896→			inPrompt = true
   897→			inSummary = false
   898→			continue
   899→		}
   900→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "summary") {
   901→			inPrompt = false
   902→			inSummary = true
   903→			continue
   904→		}
   905→		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "# ") {
   906→			inPrompt = false
   907→			inSummary = false
   908→			continue
   909→		}
   910→
   911→		if inPrompt {
   912→			promptLines = append(promptLines, line)
   913→		} else if inSummary {
   914→			summaryLines = append(summaryLines, line)
   915→		}
   916→	}
   917→
   918→	var inter interaction
   919→	if len(promptLines) > 0 {
   920→		inter.Prompt = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(promptLines, "\n"))
   921→	}
   922→	if len(summaryLines) > 0 {
   923→		inter.Responses = []string{strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(summaryLines, "\n"))}
   924→	}
   925→
   926→	// If we couldn't parse structured content, show the raw context
   927→	if inter.Prompt == "" && len(inter.Responses) == 0 {
   928→		inter.Responses = []string{contextContent}
   929→	}
   930→
   931→	if inter.Prompt != "" || len(inter.Responses) > 0 {
   932→		detail.Interactions = []interaction{inter}
   933→	}
   934→
   935→	return []checkpointDetail{detail}
   936→}

   938→// gatherCheckpointDetails extracts detailed information for each checkpoint.
   939→// Checkpoints come in newest-first order, but we number them oldest=1, newest=N.
   940→func gatherCheckpointDetails(strat strategy.Strategy, session *strategy.Session) []checkpointDetail {
   941→	details := make([]checkpointDetail, 0, len(session.Checkpoints))
   942→	total := len(session.Checkpoints)
   943→
   944→	for i, cp := range session.Checkpoints {
   945→		detail := checkpointDetail{
   946→			Index:            total - i, // Reverse numbering: oldest=1, newest=N
   947→			Timestamp:        cp.Timestamp,
   948→			IsTaskCheckpoint: cp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   949→			Message:          cp.Message,
   950→		}
   951→
   952→		// Use checkpoint ID for display (truncate long IDs)
   953→		detail.ShortID = cp.CheckpointID.String()
   954→		if len(detail.ShortID) > 12 {
   955→			detail.ShortID = detail.ShortID[:12]
   956→		}
   957→
   958→		// Try to get transcript for this checkpoint
   959→		transcriptContent, err := strat.GetCheckpointLog(cp)
   960→		if err == nil {
   961→			transcript, parseErr := parseTranscriptFromBytes(transcriptContent)
   962→			if parseErr == nil {
   963→				// Extract all prompt/response pairs from the transcript
   964→				pairs := ExtractAllPromptResponses(transcript)
   965→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   966→					detail.Interactions = append(detail.Interactions, interaction(pair))
   967→				}
   968→
   969→				// Aggregate all files for the checkpoint
   970→				fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
   971→				for _, pair := range pairs {
   972→					for _, f := range pair.Files {
   973→						if !fileSet[f] {
   974→							fileSet[f] = true
   975→							detail.Files = append(detail.Files, f)
   976→						}
   977→					}
   978→				}
   979→			}
   980→		}
   981→
   982→		details = append(details, detail)
   983→	}
   984→
   985→	return details
   986→}
